description: This file contains SQL store methods for retrieving compliance-related board and block history data, including pagination, filtering, and history extraction functions.

methods.name: getBoardsForCompliance
methods.description: Retrieves a list of boards with optional pagination and filtering for compliance purposes.

methods.name: getBoardsComplianceHistory
methods.description: Fetches historical data of boards with filtering, pagination, and optional inclusion of deleted boards.

methods.name: getBlocksComplianceHistory
methods.description: Retrieves historical data of blocks with filtering, pagination, and optional inclusion of deleted blocks.

methods.name: boardsHistoryFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a slice of BoardHistory models.

methods.name: blocksHistoryFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a slice of BlockHistory models.
